title: phrygia major
intro: Phrygia major, commonly known as Phrygian poppy, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating insomnia due to its sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in Phrygia major include alkaloids like papaverine, which exhibit therapeutic actions like vasodilation, smooth muscle relaxation, and analgesia. The plant's therapeutic actions also include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and hypnotic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
